name: Sonnet growth at a reasonable price
strategy: Cross-asset momentum/mean-reversion rotation: ride confirmed breakout trends (biotech, financials) and fade blow-off-top reversals (semis, gold miners, crypto) using price-action regime signals rather than valuation.
novelty: Unlike R1/R2's GARP quality-growth screens, this book has zero fundamental/valuation input — positions are chosen purely from trailing return inflection points (breakouts vs. breakdowns) across equities, sector ETFs and crypto, with hard stops enforcing vol-regime discipline. It explicitly shorts former winners showing 1-month reversal (SOXL, GDX, BTC) while going long assets confirming new uptrends (XBI, XLF, KRE), a relative-value/momentum-rotation edge distinct from prior long-only quality-growth stock-picking.

positions.thesis: Biotech breaking out with +14.6% 1m vs flat/negative broader tape, catalyst-driven momentum acceleration into 2H26.
Financials leading rotation (+6% 1m) as curve/rate backdrop favors banks; momentum confirmed across timeframes.
Regional banks confirming financials rotation with +5.5% 1m, higher-beta expression of same catalyst.
Long duration oversold on 3/6/12m basis, mean-reversion candidate as rate-cut expectations build; also portfolio ballast vs equity/short book.
3x semis ETF posting -39% 1m after parabolic 500%+ 12m run: classic blow-off-top reversal, momentum has flipped decisively negative.
Gold miners breaking down -13% 1m/-24% 3m after outsized run; downside momentum continuation as gold itself rolls over (-6% 1m).
BTC in confirmed downtrend (-14.7% 3m, -32.9% 6m) with momentum still negative; perp short expresses trend continuation without long funding drag.

outlook: Expect continued rotation out of extended 2025-style AI/semis/gold winners into laggard cyclicals (financials) and event-driven biotech through year-end, with crypto remaining in a technical downtrend; positioning trades price momentum/reversal signals with hard stops rather than macro forecasts, keeping 20% cash as dry powder and to cap overall portfolio beta.
